newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Tokai Bank buys 30 pct in Manila bank.
newsitem.headline: Tokai Bank buys 30 pct in Manila bank.

text.p: The Philippine central bank said on Thursday it approved the purchase of a 30 percent equity by Tokai Bank of Japan in Manila's Global Business Bank, which was formerly called Hemisphere Bank.
Tokai Bank is the 20th largest bank in the world in terms of assets and has Japanese car maker Toyota Motor Corp as its biggest shareholder, the Central Bank said.
The Central Bank said Metropolitan Bank and Trust Co will have 49 percent stake in Global Business Bank.
Other shareholders of Global are Hong Kong-based property firm Paravision Ltd (10 percent) and local real estate companies Permanent Homes Inc (eight percent) and A&E Industrial Corp (three percent).
Global Bank has an authorised capital stock of five billion pesos with two billion pesos paid-in.
